blocks.orig: ‘Nyabogati’ means ‘in the middle of it all’ in the language of the Maasai, and that is exactly where Nyabogati Camp is located – right in the heart of the Serengeti National Park, in Seronera’s Turner’s Spring, about an hour’s drive from the Naabi Gate.
blocks.html: In the Maasai language, ‘Nyabogati’ translates as ‘in the middle of it all’, which describes the location of Nyabogati Camp perfectly – it sits in the very heart of Serengeti National Park, at Turner’s Spring in Seronera’s area, roughly an hour’s drive from the Naabi Gate.

blocks.orig: The tented camp consists of 8 spacious and comfortable tents equipped with large beds, en-suite bathrooms with showers, toilets, and running water, and a private veranda. This veranda allows you to be incredibly close to nature while enjoying a magnificent panoramic view of the surrounding endless plains. The interior is decorated in warm, earthy tones, combined with white curtains for a touch of freshness. A cozy ambiance awaits you in the lounge with a library and a small area to relax before the kitchen team treats you to Italian and international dishes and fine wines – in the restaurant or under the starry African sky. Last but not least, Nyabogati strives to be ecological and prides itself to be plastic-free with all materials used being natural.
blocks.html: There are 8 spacious, comfortable tents in this tented camp, each with large beds, an en-suite bathroom with shower, toilet and running water, and a private veranda. From that veranda you are wonderfully close to nature and enjoy a superb panoramic view over the endless plains around the camp. Warm, earthy tones set the style inside, paired with white curtains that add a fresh touch. In the lounge you find a cosy atmosphere, a library and a small corner to unwind before the kitchen team serves Italian and international dishes with fine wines – in the restaurant or beneath the starry African sky. Finally, Nyabogati aims to be ecological and is proud to be plastic-free, using only natural materials.
